reports.desc: We placed an order for a Pergola 8/17/26. We received an email that it had shipped. It was supposed to arrive 8/24, then 8/25. We called 6 times and no one ever answers the phone, just a recording. Left messages Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday with our order number, name and phone number. No one ever calls back. Emailed the support contact. Email response was never received. When we go to the website to view order status it still says order processing. Not sure why a business would never answer the phone and/or never call back. Pretty sure its a scam. No further emails regarding shipping update have been received.

I was shopping for men's shoes. Found a pair on a website. Olive and Evy. The shoes were listed at 24.99 free shipping. I purchased it with my Visa credit. They charged  me 74.97 . I contacted my credit card company. They canceled my card.

I ordered an item and I received an email stating that it had shipped the next day. After waiting for a month and a half, and not receiving my item, I emailed customer service. They provided me with a link to track the shipping of my order. I had been checking the shipping periodically, but one day, the link had been disabled. I knew something was wrong when the shipper kept having nothing but problems with delivery. I contacted customer service again when the link was disabled and asked for a refund. They told me they couldn’t give me a refund immediately since the package was still out for delivery, but they had elevated my request to the highest priority level.

Came across an ad for a neckline massager to do four different functions. Stating it would relieve dizziness intention in the neck. Receive device all it does is vibrate. This device is cheap and deceptive. When contacted by email they responded by saying they would give 50% refund. 10 emails later in correspondence nothing has transpired in the form of a refund. I don't know why they keep carrying on a conversation when they're not going to intentionally refund the money. Very deceptive company very .. dishonest company! Trying to protect others from making the same mistake by purchasing one of these from this dishonest company.
Ordered cargo shorts that have not been delivered.  Now asking for $15.00 to try and complete shipment.

I booked a cruise through this person.  I was told it was paid in full and we were "all set".  I checked on the cruise website and yes,  the cruise was booked!!  I was emailed by connie this week that all reservation are being canceled and that her company is no more.   Where's my money?  I contacted the cruise line and yes,  she canceled it,  but she had only placed a non refundable deposit of $500.  I was told it was paid in full.... where's the rest?   Also, in order for me to use the $500, I need the TRAVEL ADVISOR to sign off on it,..... which she can't because her attorney won't allow her to speak to clients.  After reading other peoples struggles with the agent,  I consider myself lucky it wasn't a larger amount.

I received an email from the sender l who is an old college friend. It was a paperless post e-invite which of course I trusted. But, something seemed off because when I clicked the link to sign in, to view the invitation, it took me to my email. That spoofed me so I quickly changed my password and signed out all of my devices. I’m not positive his email was hacked and they are trying to get people in his contacts.

I got scammed out of a product that was too good to be true. I shouldve known better when the adress they listed lead to either a warehouse in the middle of nowhere or just a tall building that showed no trace of the shop as shown on the website. After cancelling and receiving a new card, I still kept getting failed "delivery" attempts shown on their postal tracker.
Product is supposed to project moving images on ceilings....it does nothing.
I ordered the pants I never received they keep saying they are on their way. No tracking one no email respond.  Order #SOV29780 tracking number DZT9387429689U.

I purchased a dress at Barbara Dever Boutique website. The item I ordered was not what I expected, as the quality is terrible and the color did not match the picture on the site. There is no mention of the fiber content on any of the dresses. The site shows photos of people opening these nicely staged boxes with tissue paper. My item came in a very small, balled up bag in a tiny box. The return policy is attached. They will not return or refund. They only offer a 15% refund. I've emailed at least 5 times. I feel like the response is AI generated. I hope this business can be wiped off the planet.

They are sending me text messages offering $850,000 credit line. They used my legal name.
I have not replied to them.
Keeps calling and goes to VM and telling me that I have a vacation package to use.

This company, Mobileho which exclaimed to be affiliated with PayPal took 15.00 dollars in three separate transactions using my debit card. In my checking transactions info for each the give a telephone number 402-935-7733. This number leads the what sounds like a PayPal customer service #.
PayPal has no record of this transaction, no 402 area code reference, and has never heard of Mobileho. Mobileho is said to be a charitable organization. I found this out from the dispute with my bank. I'm the only user on this account.
